**Calculating values without tools**

I need to compute some values without using tools. I start with the original coordinates: OG S4 (-3.091, -7.517, -3.076) and CA G31 (-8.433, -0.526, -3.558). The differences come out to be (-5.342, 6.991, -0.482). When I square those and add them together, I get about 77.643369. I think the square root is roughly 8.811547, which I can round to 8.81. I’ll double-check the difference too.
